svg.title: SIM-ddd-sequence — source snapshot (not a runtime trace)

g.text: SIM-ddd-sequence — source snapshot (not a runtime trace)
Validate UI permission vs API operationId input contract;
choose explicit target userId or actor.id().
non-ACTIVE → USER_DISABLED; otherwise disabled system → SYSTEM_DISABLED;
No effective()/api() call for unavailable target.
UI uses Effective.has; reason ALLOW or DENY;
explain trace records TOKEN_VALID, USER_SYSTEM_ACTIVE and requirement result
RestSupport.ok supplies HTTP envelope; target disabled is a DENY result,
not authentication failure of the requesting administrator.
No business mutation or SUCCESS audit occurs in this simulation.
